zh.settings.customHint:
支持图片 PNG / JPG / WebP / GIF（≤15MB）与 3D 模型 GLB（≤60MB）。
「单张图片」：整体显示，程序自动做呼吸 / 行走 / 睡眠 / 跳跃动画；
「精灵表」：需要 4 行 × 4 列、行序 idle / walking / sleeping / click，每帧等大；
「3D 模型」：GLB 格式，程序自动适配大小并做待机 / 行走 / 睡眠 / 点击动画，点击判定用射线检测；
「2.5D 立牌」：单张图片放进 3D 场景，朝向光标转动、拖拽倾斜，看起来立体、本质是平片。
zh.settings.autoMoveHint: 开启后宠物会自己在桌面上走动 / 奔跑 / 跳跃，并保持清醒不再自动入睡；关闭则按上面的「睡眠等待」入睡。任何点击或拖拽都会打断自主活动。
zh.settings.behaviorHint: 「贴边吸附」会在拖拽松手时把宠物贴齐最近的屏幕边缘；关闭「只在单屏活动」后，宠物走动时可以跨到另一块显示器。

en.settings.cutoutHint: Removes a solid / simple background by colour tolerance and saves the result as a transparent PNG; the image is never uploaded. Higher strength removes more background. Works best on clean backgrounds.
en.settings.markEyesHint: Click the left eye, then the right eye in the preview. Afterwards the pupils follow your cursor and blink (photo pets in "Single image" mode only).
en.settings.eyesFail: No photo available — import one first
en.settings.customHint:
Supports images PNG / JPG / WebP / GIF (≤15MB) and 3D models GLB (≤60MB).
"Single image": shown as-is with procedural breathing / walking / sleeping / click animation.
"Sprite sheet": 4 rows × 4 columns, row order idle / walking / sleeping / click, equal frames.
"3D model": GLB format, auto-fitted size with procedural idle / walking / sleeping / click animation; hit testing uses raycasting.
"2.5D standee": a single image placed in the 3D scene — it turns toward the cursor and leans while dragging, so it looks 3D while staying a flat plane.
en.settings.autoMoveHint: When on, the pet walks / runs / jumps around your desktop on its own and stays awake (no auto-sleep); when off it falls asleep after the "Sleep after" delay above. Any click or drag interrupts the wandering.
en.settings.behaviorHint: "Snap to edges" pulls the pet flush to the nearest screen edge when you drop it. Turn off "Stay on one display" to let it wander across to another monitor.
